critical_safety_constraints.rule: DJI Ronin 4D contains an integrated 4-axis motorized gimbal. Never add an external DJI RS3/RS4 gimbal to a Ronin 4D package.
CHIOPT cine zooms (2.8kg) require 15mm baseplate rods and lens support bracket. Without rods, the lens weight damages the camera mount.
Packages exceeding NPR 50,000 replacement value or containing RED, Ronin 4D, Mantis, Great Joy, CHIOPT, or NiSi Athena lenses require the Babin Camera Caretaker service (NPR 2,000/day).
